style: Say this like an energetic young American guy hosting a viral would-you-rather Short, punchy and a little smug

lines.a: Would you rather get one million dollars, right now...
lines.b: or one penny that doubles every single day, for thirty days?
lines.d10: Day ten. Five dollars and twelve cents. Yeah... you're losing.
lines.d20: Day twenty. Five thousand bucks. Still losing.
lines.end: Five point three million dollars. So... did you pick right?
